title: Songbook and Vow
author: Hazel Delacroix
blurb: Isandro Hartwell, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the festival ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
